presentation.tooltip_btn_pause: Pause or resume the running scenario - the countdown to the next step stops and picks up again exactly where it left off.
presentation.tooltip_btn_step: Execute the next step immediately, without waiting for its scheduled time.
presentation.tooltip_btn_stop: Stops the scenario and restores every value it changed back to what it was before Start.

historian_export.title: Export Historical Data
historian_export.hint: Exports raw tag history (value-over-time trend data) to CSV for the selected date range and tags.

alarms.tooltip_btn_acknowledge: Confirm you've seen this alarm - silences the unacknowledged flag but does not clear the underlying condition. Operator level or higher.
alarms.tooltip_col_activated: Time this alarm first became active.
alarms.tooltip_col_ack: Who acknowledged this alarm and when.

protection.reset_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to reset all protection statistics?
protection.tooltip_btn_reset_stats: Zero the Pickups/Trips/OpTime counters for every protection function. Engineer level.
protection.tooltip_col_hysteresis: Margin the measured value must fall back below the setting by before this protection resets (prevents chattering near the threshold).
protection.tooltip_col_delay: Time the condition must persist before this protection acts, in milliseconds.
protection.tooltip_col_actual_value: The live measured value this protection function is comparing against its Setting.
protection.tooltip_col_statistics: Pickups = times the condition was detected. Trips = times it actually acted. OpTime = operate time. LP/LT = last pickup/last trip time.
protection.tooltip_col_logic: Which Logic Studio program element (if any) this protection function is linked to.

protection_process.gate_configure_message: Log in as Engineer to add, edit, or remove process protections.
protection_process.tooltip_hysteresis: Margin the reading must fall back inside the band by before Exceeded clears (prevents chattering right at the threshold).
protection_process.tooltip_delay: How long the reading must stay outside the band before Exceeded actually latches (filters a brief spike/glitch). 0 = latches immediately.
protection_process.tooltip_output_tag: The BOOL tag this protection publishes for logic to react to - True while exceeded. Auto-named from this protection's own id, not editable.
protection_process.err_lower_above_upper: The lower threshold can't be above the upper threshold.

bus_diagnostics.title: BUS DIAGNOSTICS
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_btn_reset: Zero every device's frame/error/response-time counters and clear the recent errors list. Engineer level.
bus_diagnostics.gate_message: Log in as Engineer to view bus diagnostics.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_id: The device identifier as registered with the driver layer - no distinct bus address exists yet without a real Modbus driver.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_sent: Frames sent to this device since the last reset.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_received: Frames received back from this device since the last reset.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_timeout: Exchanges that got no response at all within the timeout.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_crc: Exchanges rejected due to a checksum/CRC mismatch.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_invalid: Exchanges that got a response, but not a valid one (wrong length, unexpected function code, ...).
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_last_ms: Response time of the most recent successful exchange.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_avg_ms: Average response time across every successful exchange since the last reset.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_worst_ms: Slowest response time recorded since the last reset.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_since_success: Time elapsed since this device's last successful exchange.
bus_diagnostics.tooltip_col_success_pct: Percentage of sent frames that got a valid response (received / sent).

intrusion.gate_arm_message: Log in as Operator or higher to arm/disarm zones.
intrusion.gate_configure_message: Log in as Engineer to configure zones and lines.
intrusion.tooltip_col_violated: This line's current state versus its configured secure (normal) state.
intrusion.tooltip_col_bypass: Temporarily excludes this line from arming/alarm checks - recorded to the audit log either way. Engineer level.
intrusion.confirm_arm_message: Zone '{zone}' has one or more violated lines right now. Arm anyway?
intrusion.tooltip_min_violation: The input must stay tripped longer than this before it counts as a violation - filters brief glitches and contact bounce. 0 = off (any trip counts immediately, as today).
intrusion.tooltip_multiplicity_count: How many violations within the window (right) are needed before this line alarms. 1 = off (a single violation alarms immediately, as today).
intrusion.tooltip_multiplicity_window: Time window the violation count is measured over. Resets to 0 if no further violation arrives before it elapses.
intrusion.tooltip_lockout_after: After this many alarms from this line in one arm cycle, it auto-locks and stops alarming until the zone is disarmed. 0 = off (never auto-locks).
intrusion.tooltip_alarm_hold: How long the ALARM state is held after a violation before automatically returning to ARMED, once this line is no longer violated. 0 = off (stays in alarm until manually disarmed, as today).
intrusion.err_zone_has_lines: This zone still has lines assigned - remove or reassign them first.
intrusion.err_no_zones_yet: Add a zone first, under Configure Zones.
intrusion.err_input_required: Select an input for this line.
intrusion.warn_mode_change_clears_input: Changing the input mode clears the currently selected input - it must be reassigned before saving.
intrusion.tooltip_silence_threshold: If this line goes this long without a single violation, it is marked SUSPECT (possibly a dead detector or a cut cable) - a warning only, shown on screen and logged, never an alarm. 0 = off.
intrusion.suspect_suffix: suspect - no violation for a while
intrusion.alarm_memory_active: An alarm has occurred since the last clear.
intrusion.alarm_memory_inactive: No unacknowledged alarm on record for this zone.
intrusion.alarm_memory_subsequent_header: Further alarms since (not the first cause):
intrusion.msg_no_history: There is nothing to export - no history rows match the current filters.
intrusion.tooltip_retention_max_events: The oldest events are deleted once this many are stored. 0 = unlimited.
intrusion.tooltip_retention_max_days: Events older than this are deleted. 0 = unlimited.

feature_config.title: Feature Configuration
feature_config.intro: Turn individual controller functions on or off. This is not just hiding a page - an OFF function stops its module entirely: no background threads, no tags in TagManager, nothing written to disk, and it disappears from the navigation tree. Changes take effect immediately, no restart.
feature_config.note_data_intrusion: Alarm history and alarm memory will stop updating.
feature_config.note_data_analog_inputs: New readings for these points will stop being recorded in the Historian until this is re-enabled.
feature_config.note_data_trends: Measurement data keeps being recorded in the background either way - only this page's own live/history view disappears.
feature_config.note_data_switching_counters: Switching counters will stop updating until this is re-enabled.
feature_config.note_data_service_notes: New service notes can't be added until this is re-enabled.
feature_config.warn_logic_uses_tags: Your logic program references tags this feature publishes - they will disappear.
feature_config.tooltip_engineer_mode_needs_protection: Engineer Mode verifies the ACTUAL configured Protection Settings - it needs that feature enabled to mean anything, so it's unavailable while Protection Settings is off.
feature_config.tooltip_intrusion_subpage_needs_intrusio: Event History and Configuration both view/edit the Intrusion Alarm System's own data - they're unavailable while the Intrusion Alarm System itself is off.

mqtt.title: MQTT Integration
mqtt.hint: Publishes tags, alarms, and system events to an MQTT broker for Home Assistant or other EPW controllers to consume - never the other way around. This integration can only ever be told about data from another controller's Link.* signals; it can never receive an arm/disarm/force/setpoint command. Disabled by default - existing installations are unaffected until this is turned on here.
mqtt.library_missing_warning: The 'paho-mqtt' package is not installed in this environment - the integration will stay inactive even if enabled below. Install it with: pip install paho-mqtt
mqtt.unavailable_in_this_session: MQTT integration is not available in this session.
mqtt.stats_line: Sent: {sent}   Received: {received}   Errors: {errors}   Dropped (queue full): {dropped}   Last connected: {last_connect}
mqtt.password_placeholder: (unchanged - leave blank to keep the current password)
mqtt.link_in_hint: Read-only data from another controller, mapped to a local tag named Link.<identifier>.In<name>. These are informational only - never treated as a command by this program. A mapping with no update for longer than its own staleness time is marked STALE, the same as any other supervised signal.
mqtt.invalid_mapping: Invalid mapping: topic {topic!r} / tag {tag!r} - the local tag must be named Link.<identifier>.In<name>, and the topic must not be blank.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.hint: Historian (measurement history) and the audit log (who changed what) are two separate concerns with two separate settings below - each is off by default and never deletes anything until explicitly configured.
retention.stats_line: Database file: {size} — tag_history: {tag_history} rows, audit_log: {audit_log} rows, alarm_history: {alarm_history} rows, intrusion_alarm_history: {intrusion_alarm_history} rows.
retention.audit_archive_note: The audit log is never simply deleted. Before any row is removed, it is written to a CSV archive file first - if that write fails for any reason, nothing is purged.
retention.tooltip_archive_dir: Where audit log CSV archives are written before old rows are purged. Left blank, a built-in default location is used.
retention.chk_enable_size_warning: Warn when the database file exceeds:
